You are trusting someone to work on openings that affect your home’s appearance, security, comfort, and energy performance. We have served Utah as a window, entry door, and shower door provider since 1985, bringing decades of hands-on experience to every project. Our team believes that quality work begins with listening. We take the time to learn what is motivating your project, whether you are dealing with broken glass, uncomfortable drafts, rising energy costs, excessive noise, outdated frames, or windows that no longer operate properly. From there, we provide straightforward recommendations based on the needs of your home rather than pushing a one-size-fits-all product. We are equipped to handle projects of many different sizes, from an individual window repair to a complete home window replacement. Throughout the process, we focus on accurate measurements, dependable products, careful installation, and clear communication. We do not believe in cutting corners, and we want every client to feel confident that the project was completed properly the first time. Ask us about available lifetime warranty options when discussing your window project. Why Clients Choose The Brokerage Windows & Doors Clients choose The Brokerage Windows & Doors because we provide more than a basic window installation. We offer access to numerous window styles, brands, glass packages, and custom configurations, allowing each project to be tailored to the property. Instead of limiting you to a small selection, we help compare options based on appearance, energy efficiency, privacy, noise reduction, maintenance, operation, and budget. Our experience with both window replacement and window repair also allows us to provide practical guidance. Not every damaged window requires a complete replacement, and not every older window is worth continuing to repair. We can evaluate concerns such as broken glass, moisture between panes, failed insulated glass units, damaged hardware, worn seals, difficult operation, and deteriorating frames. You will receive a clear recommendation designed to help you make the right long-term decision. We also understand that replacing windows is an investment in your entire home. New energy-efficient windows can help make rooms more comfortable, refresh the exterior, improve natural light, reduce outside noise, and support more efficient heating and cooling. Our team manages the details from product selection and accurate measurement through installation and final review, making the experience as easy and convenient as possible. Whether you are searching for replacement windows in Salt Lake City, custom windows for a remodeling project, energy-efficient windows for improved year-round comfort, or window repair for damaged glass and hardware, we are ready to help. Reach out to The Brokerage Windows & Doors to discuss your project, explore your options, and request a professional estimate. A Company You Can Trust Exterior doors require careful planning and precise installation. Even a beautiful, well-made door may not perform as intended when it is ordered in the wrong size, installed out of alignment, or poorly sealed around the frame. That is why every project begins with professional measurements and a conversation about what you want to improve. We take the time to understand whether your priority is appearance, security, energy efficiency, natural light, privacy, noise reduction, or a combination of several goals. From there, we help you select a door configuration that fits the opening, complements the home, and stays within your preferred budget. Our team handles the measuring, ordering, and installation so the process remains clear and organized from beginning to end. The Brokerage Windows & Doors has served Utah homeowners since 1985. That experience has taught us that good craftsmanship is found in the details. Proper alignment, clean trim, secure hardware, effective weather sealing, and clear communication all contribute to a successful installation. We complete our work professionally and without cutting corners, giving you confidence in both the appearance and performance of your new door. Why Clients Choose The Brokerage Windows & Doors Choosing a shower door involves more than selecting a piece of glass. The enclosure must be carefully planned around the shower opening, bathroom layout, and way the space will be used. A door that is measured or installed incorrectly may not operate smoothly or provide the finished appearance you expected. Our team brings decades of experience to the process and pays close attention to every stage of the project. We begin by learning what you want to accomplish. You may be replacing an old enclosure, removing a shower curtain, updating a guest bathroom, or completing a full primary bathroom renovation. We will discuss the look you prefer, evaluate the available space, and help you choose a custom shower door that balances style, function, and maintenance. Our team can visit your home to review the shower area and take the necessary measurements. We also welcome clients to our showroom, where they can explore design possibilities and ask questions in person. This combination of personalized service and hands-on guidance makes it easier to select a shower door with confidence. Since 1985, The Brokerage Windows & Doors has helped Utah homeowners improve their properties with professionally measured, ordered, and installed products.
